basis: Prototype mechanical retention: four frame sections seat on six enclosure hard stops before the PCB is installed. Lower sections enter 3.8 mm inward and 0.15 mm raised, slide outward below the PCB edge ledges, then seat. Upper sections enter 10 mm inward and 8 mm toward the buttons to clear lid/PCB posts; at the raised seating height slide up 8 mm, then outward 10 mm and lower. Nonconductive display-compatible pads touch only the border. Rear pads are modeled at 0.5 mm installed thickness (0.6 mm free thickness, nominal 0.1 mm compression); actual pad softness, tolerance, printed fit and retention need sample testing. M1.6 machine-screw pilots must be tapped before fitting the glass; no heat-set insert is modeled.
